what: Photo strip: two more copies of the strip are appended so one set flows endlessly left every 20s. On every scroll movement the speed (px/s ÷ 200, max 3x · 1.2x if slow) changes the playback rate over .3s — scrolling up makes it flow in reverse on the spot, and after scrolling stops it keeps flowing at the last rate (usually 1.2x). Below 769px it is not tied to scroll and flows on the 20s loop only.

options.dur: Duration for one set to pass (sec), default 20
options.idle: Playback rate when scroll is slow (|v| ≤ 10), default 1.2
options.div: Divisor that converts speed to a multiplier, default 200
options.flip: if false, it does not play in reverse even when scrolling back up
options.dir: With right, it flows to the right (default left)
options.min: Minimum window width (px) where scroll binding applies, default 769
options.[data-fx-part=track]: One flow set (child) — as wide as the panel. Parts attach two more sets (data-fx-part=clone)

from.where: index.html photo strip (original .home-marquee — Marquee class: two copies, xPercent −100 · 20s · repeat −1, timeScale in ScrollTrigger onUpdate = Direction × (|v|>10 ? min(|v|/200, 3) : 1.2) over .3s)
